segments.text: Intelligent automation is becoming part of the everyday experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

With the payables agent, the tedious task for handling vendor invoice processing end-to-end is soon a thing of the past. It's designed to reduce manual work, speed up invoice processing, and give your team more time to focus on what matters most.

When an invoice arrives, the payables agent automatically drafts a purchase invoice and uses AI and historical data to suggest the vendor, invoice line types, and other information such as dimensions and deferral templates.
We open the PDF to verify the invoice details. The agent extracts the data and presents it in a structured format. We review the information and confirm it when everything looks correct.

The payables agent doesn't post anything automatically and keeps us in control. We can review, accept, or adjust each suggestion before confirming. Once the draft is finalized as a purchase invoice, the agent's role is complete.

At that point, the agent supervisor can either send it for approval or proceed directly with posting it, depending on the setup. Start transforming your vendor invoice processing today with payables agent in Business Central.
